name: seal-assurance-kit
description: Assurance kit for MCP tool mediation: verify decision receipts, test boundary conformance, audit policy coverage, and check finite monitor adequacy.

scripts.verify: node bin/seal verify fixtures/receipt-block.json && node bin/seal verify fixtures/receipt-allow.json && node bin/seal verify fixtures/receipt-crosstool.json
scripts.test: node src/gen-receipt.cjs && npm run --silent verify && npm run --silent test:bypass && npm run --silent test:format && npm run --silent test:adequacy
scripts.test:bypass: node test/expect-fail.cjs node bin/seal verify fixtures/receipt-bypass.json
